name: Default
tagline: Sensible questions for a deck with no house style yet.

scope_questions.why: Sets the tone the engine writes in — numbers-forward vs narrative-first.

scope_questions.prompt: What should they decide, do, or believe when you finish?
scope_questions.why: A deck with no ask is a status update. This becomes the closing bumper.

scope_questions.prompt: What happens if they say no?
scope_questions.placeholder: We lose the Q1 window and the pipeline ages out
scope_questions.why: Stakes are what make the middle of the deck matter.

scope_questions.prompt: What is your strongest piece of evidence?
scope_questions.placeholder: Net retention 118% in the segment we want to expand
scope_questions.why: The engine leads with this; everything else supports it.

scope_questions.prompt: What will they push back on hardest?
scope_questions.placeholder: That the churn drop is seasonal, not structural
scope_questions.why: An unanswered objection sinks the deck in the room, not in the draft.
Caps the deck length before the engine writes a slide you will cut.

narrative.bumper_rule: Every slide ends in one sentence that sets up the next.

rules: At most three messages per slide.
Every slide carries a title that argues, not a label.
Numbers get units and a comparison.
